queries.horizonsSample: Full calendar year, all stations and all tropical sign ingresses, for every body-year in the bound sample plan.
queries.horizonsOriginal: Full calendar year of each original reference case, retaining its body and event policy, without a direction filter.
queries.loops: Each independent loop source window, as a longitude crossing and as a fixed conjunction to the same invented longitude.
queries.nasa: Full calendar year, solar and lunar separately, for every year in the bound sample plan; pad by the derivative half-width and filter back to the requested window.

matching: Unique identity inside the independent source window for Horizons, or kind and full TT catalog date for NASA, before comparing timing or classification. Ambiguous candidates are not assigned.
calendarOwnership: Calendar year and date windows include their midnight and exclude the next midnight, encoded as integer search coordinates one millisecond before each midnight.
scope: Fixed selected years and source windows spanning 1900 through 2100, not a continuous inventory of that span. Horizons coverage is sparse; NASA covers every retained catalog row in the selected years.
